title: Penix returns, but protection is the next question for Falcons–Packers
excerpt: Atlanta’s quarterback change is confirmed. At 44.5, protection uncertainty and the possibility of fewer turnover-assisted points complicate an automatic over.

title: Rays–Yankees nightcap: the lineup question behind 6.5
excerpt: The Yankees’ injury picture points in different directions. Fourth & Value is watching the evening lineup and afternoon workload—not treating a low total as an automatic under.

title: Peyton Watson’s Cavaliers fit is not an automatic under
excerpt: Watson’s defensive role gives Cleveland a useful preseason test. It does not establish a totals edge, particularly with shooting, availability and rotation questions unresolved.

title: Hurricanes–Panthers: Read the roster before the rematch
excerpt: Carolina is going young again against Florida. The shortened preseason makes personnel and goalie usage essential—but without fresh prices or a validated model, this remains a watchlist.

title: Chargers–Bills: the tight-end reset is bigger than Gadsden's targets
excerpt: Njoku and Kolar are headed to injured reserve. Gadsden gains opportunity, but replacing their different assignments makes Chargers–Bills a role-based watchlist rather than an automatic under.

title: Brewers–Phillies: separate Wheeler’s rebound from the total
excerpt: Zack Wheeler’s recent form supports run prevention. Dustin May’s uneven workload complicates the full-game total—and our model evidence cannot resolve the disagreement.

title: Astros and Dodgers: price the available role, not the headline
excerpt: Houston’s seven-inning relief effort and Ohtani’s expected return raise different availability questions. Neither supports a bet without confirmed roles and a current price.

title: Padres–Dodgers at 7.5: the clinching clock matters before first pitch
excerpt: San Diego could clinch before taking the field Thursday. That makes lineup and bullpen decisions worth watching—but does not yet make either side of 7.5 a bet.

title: Falcons–Packers at 43: Penix returns, and two props move to the recheck list
excerpt: The total is steady around 43. Fourth & Value’s saved prop board points to Michael Penix attempts and Tucker Kraft receptions—but both prices need a fresh check.

title: Rays–Phillies: Sánchez’s strikeout price deserves a closer look
excerpt: An experimental forecast favors Cristopher Sánchez under 5.5 strikeouts, but the useful question is whether Tampa Bay’s lineup and his workload justify the offered price.

title: Falcons 35, Packers 14: Penix under wins, Kraft under misses
excerpt: Atlanta’s offensive revival carried the game over 43, while our two saved prop signals split. The result shows why passing volume, scoring and price need separate scorecards.

title: Jayden Daniels is out. How much does Washington actually lose?
excerpt: The healthy version of Daniels changes Washington’s ceiling. Last year’s splits tell a messier story—and the next four games will test how much Marcus Mariota can preserve.

title: Snell’s strikeout under: a workload question, not a shutdown call
excerpt: The Dodgers’ postseason preparations put starter workload in focus. Our experimental Snell forecast favors under 7.5 strikeouts, but Friday’s pitching decisions are not a Saturday innings limit.

title: Chargers–Bills at 50: Buffalo’s efficiency puts possession control to the test
excerpt: Buffalo’s scoring surge makes the over tempting, but Sunday’s total hinges on possessions as well as efficiency. A split between 50 and 50.5 matters without establishing an edge.

title: Fourth & Value Power Rankings: The Best Franchise to Root for in Each Sport
excerpt: Steelers, Braves, Celtics, Red Wings and Galaxy: our opinion ranking weighs championships, lasting contention, tradition and the misery tax of being a fan.
